diagnosis: The payroll bonus approval method uses @PreAuthorize to confirm that the user holds the role DEPARTMENT_MANAGER, but does not verify whether the manager has jurisdiction over the specified department ID. A department manager from Marketing can approve high-value discretionary cash bonuses for employees in Finance or Engineering.
